card.name: Just before a number or numeral
card.fires_on: Small connecting marks or words right before a number is expected, such as "No.", "0%(", "start at", or the space before a year or section number.

modes.label: Before a count or percent
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after 0% that leads into a count like 0/60.

modes.label: Before a reference number
modes.description: A word, period or space just before a numbered item, volume, or section number.

modes.label: Before a numeral in prose
modes.description: A word like at, or the abbreviation No, leading into a digit.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or mark that comes just before a number in the text.
